name: verdandi-gauntlet2

provenance.tool: kernel/main.rs --gauntlet2-bench (one thread count per process, interleaved) + verify/gauntlet2.py
provenance.host_line: os=windows arch=x86_64 cpu="AMD64 Family 26 Model 36 Stepping 0, AuthenticAMD"
provenance.instrument: interleaved per-thread-count strips, one T per process

validity_scope.certifies: the same-apparatus p99 of the threaded emit at thread counts [1, 2, 4, 8, 16] vs the inherited single-thread baseline on host DANIELDILLBERG for scene witness with identity tiles, 300 samples x 8 interleaved strips

forbidden_interpretations: input-to-photon latency, a present, a window, a compositor, a refresh-rate claim: none is in this number
the whole-render cost: this is emit only, over the frozen strips + frame every thread count shares
any comparison to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute (a different apparatus)
the single-thread baseline as re-derived here: it is INHERITED from the sealed LOCALITY-0 record, unchanged
the per-T p99 as a pure core-count law: cache/bandwidth/scheduling make scaling sublinear, and a plateau is a memory-hierarchy finding, not a call for more threads
any other host, scene, tile set, resolution or core count; absolute us are host-specific
that the threaded emit is promoted by this record: promotion is the reader's, from the decision rule and the p99 matrix
reading: the parallel-execution court on host DANIELDILLBERG, off-gate, interleaved over 8 strips (per-T p99 medians): T1=5019, T2=3752, T4=3012, T8=2360, T16=2311 us; inherited single-thread baseline 7734 us (sealed by LOCALITY-0, never re-derived). PROMOTE: parallel execution beats the sealed single-thread baseline — best at T=16 with p99 2311 us vs baseline 7734 us (3346 permille of it), and p99 kept improving out to the largest T tested. Action for the reader: adopt the threaded emit; the parallel court is open for higher T if the platform has the cores. Byte-identity was proven FIRST at every T (gauntlet2-threaded-equiv), so the threaded emit is the certified picture at every thread count. These are same-apparatus p99 deltas vs the sealed single-thread baseline — NOT compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute, and NOT a refresh-rate or input-to-photon claim.
